scene: The robot clicks open a rear hatch revealing three unusual transit exits.
picture: Flat side view of the rear lane exit. On the far left sits a bamboo cable car docked at an open railing. Left of centre, the player in her red bomber jacket and roller skates holds a glowing pin beside the open brass robot. Up high floats a paper-lantern balloon basket. Far right stands a brass revolving door.
shown: a green bamboo cable car suspended over a dock on the left
a glowing red paper-lantern balloon floating tethered up high
a patterned brass revolving door framed in puzzle motifs on the far right
